entry.name: rnbo_beatstohz
entry.digest: convert beat time (quarter notes) to frequency (Hz)
entry.description: Use the beatstohz object to convert an incoming number from beats values to hertz (Hz) using the tempo of the device transport.

arguments.name: beattime
arguments.description: The number of beats (quarter notes) to be converted to the equivalent time in Hz using the tempo of the device transport.
